candidates.summary: unplot_and_move_mover / move_mover: (a) JSR move_mover_routine_address's high byte is the same for all four routines (HI ASSERTed), so it is assembled into the JSR (JSR move_mover_up_and_right, only the low byte self-modified) and the LDA #HI / STA move_mover_routine_address_high pair goes (6 cycles, 5 bytes every move); (b) the JSR get_mover_Y_x after the unplot is put in line (JSR + RTS = 12 cycles per unplot, 7 bytes more). Net +2 bytes: the code after moves up by 2. Measured on the unshifted DEBUG_LIVES bench build (scratch copy, pcprof, 2026-10-22): logic work a pass 9440 -> 9412 on seed 1 (render unchanged), RIGHT 38661 -> 38637 (logic -26, render +2). Alternative to the next candidate (overlaps it; includes its part (a)).
candidates.equivalence: (b): the in-line LDA movers_x_low,Y / STA mover_x_low / LDA movers_x_high,Y / STA &C5 are get_mover_Y_x's body (its RTS removed with its JSR); registers and flags afterwards are the same (A = x high, N/Z from it, C untouched, X and Y untouched, Y = mover_to_update loaded just before), and only the return address on the stack differs, popped again at once. (a): the only code that stores to the JSR's operand is this routine (grep move_mover_routine_address in src/ and tools/: game.6502 only); the high byte stored was always HI(move_mover_up_and_right) and ASSERT HI(move_mover_up_and_right) = HI(move_mover_down_and_left) (kept, before the y_down stub) with the +6 ASSERTs puts all four routines in that page, so the assembled operand is the same value as the one stored. A (HI, dead: animate_mover starts LDA #&80), N, Z at the JSR animate_mover differ and nothing reads them. move_mover_set_43fa is entered only by fall-through and by the y_down stub's BRA, both with X = the low byte and A dead. The JSR operand is read as ever after STX move_mover_routine_address_low. The player's entry at .move_mover (JSR move_mover from the player update) is untouched; get_mover_Y_x itself stays (plot_mover calls it).
candidates.relies_on: No data moves and no new RAM; the JSR's low operand byte is still written by the STX right before animate_mover. Page crossings: the window's code from the y_down stub's BRA on stays put, .unplot_and_move_mover at &20EB; .move_mover_set_43fa goes &210B -> &2112 and everything after the window moves up 2 bytes (to_scroll_screen_right &2165 -> &2167; the window's own taken branches, BPL move_mover_x_done_43fa &20FF+ and BMI move_mover_y_down_43fa, stay as they were: BPL does not cross, the BMI/BRA of the 6% y-down path cross as before). Everything from &2118 to &3400 in game.6502 slides 2 bytes (the SKIP unused_3400_original absorbs it: 193 free). Measured in a scratch bench build: render work unchanged on seed 1, +2 cycles a pass on RIGHT, so no hot branch or table read crossed a page on those games; the gate's measurement decides. Builds assembled: bench, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW twin, ship and release.
